proposal.reasoning: The torch cannot be equipped, so it offers no combat benefit. The goblin warrior blocks both exits and deals 22 damage per turn; my attack is 10 and its health is 31. Direct attack would likely kill me again. I have no usable weapon. One remaining option is to attack anyway, hoping to deal enough damage before dying, but that is risky. Alternatively, I could drop the torch and satchel to free hands, but that doesn't improve combat. Given the blocked exits and lack of alternatives, attacking is the only way to potentially clear the goblin, even if risky.
